WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id, w.status,
  COUNT(*) AS n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) gross, SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
LEFT JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd
WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB') AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order),
l AS (
SELECT d.fiscal_period, f.*, p.vat_class, p.category
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN wd w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.status IN ('delivered','collected') AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6)
SELECT fiscal_period, vat_rate, vat_class, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id,
  SUM(gross_amount) gross, SUM(net_amount) net, SUM(ROUND(net_amount*(1+vat_rate),2)) calc_gross,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(gross_amount-net_amount*(1+vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullg, MIN(etl_loaded_at), MAX(etl_loaded_at)
FROM l GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, status, line_count, order_total_gross, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order),
lines AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.line_no) dn, SUM(f.gross_amount) g,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.store_id<>900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonweb_store, MAX(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_test
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order) OR s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, o.status,
  COUNT(*) orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) dist_orders,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.receipt_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.n<>o.line_count THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) linecount_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN l.n<>l.dn THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) dup_lineno,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(l.g-o.order_total_gross)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) total_mismatch,
  SUM(l.nonweb_store) nonweb, SUM(l.has_test) test_orders, SUM(o.order_total_gross) ordtot, SUM(l.g) linegross
FROM o JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=o.dd
LEFT JOIN lines l ON l.receipt_id=o.web_order_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'orphan_lines_no_order' k, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.gross_amount) g FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE (s.store_id=900 OR f.channel_code='WB') AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30' AND f.receipt_id NOT IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'wb_not_900', COUNT(*), SUM(f.gross_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.channel_code='WB' AND s.store_id<>900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT '900_not_WB', COUNT(*), SUM(f.gross_amount) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 WHERE f.channel_code<>'WB' AND s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-07-01' AND DATE '2024-11-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_sales_line_id_all', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id), 0 FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_receipt_line_all', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), 0 FROM fact_sales_line
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_web_order', COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id), 0 FROM fact_web_order

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date, f.gross_amount, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_quarter, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(SUM(l.gross_amount), 2) AS web_sales_incl_vat,
       ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS web_net_excl_vat,
       (SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date
         WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year=d.fiscal_year AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) AS rpt_net_before_returns
FROM lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 4 AND 6
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY 3
